body.statement: For the binary input \(V_{\star}=\{a,b,c,d\}\), \(C_{\star}=\{K_a,K_b,K_{cd}\}\), \(H_{\star}\), \(EX_{\star}=\{K_a\}\), and \(EY_{\star}=\{K_b\}\) in the explicit construction, \(G_{1\star}\) and \(G_{2\star}\) are acyclic exact refinements of \(H_{\star}\). Their common skeleton is \(K_4\) without \(c-d\), neither graph has an unshielded collider, and their common positive observational model is characterized by \(c\mathrel{\perp\!\!\!\perp}d\mid(a,b)\). The displayed law \(p_{\star}\) is strictly positive and factorizes over both graphs. The inverse-CDF models \(M_{1\star}\) and \(M_{2\star}\) have exact active graphs \(G_{1\star}\) and \(G_{2\star}\), respectively, and both induce \(p_{\star}\). Nevertheless, \(\Pr_{M_{1\star}}(b=1\mid\operatorname{do}(a=0))=1/4\) whereas \(\Pr_{M_{2\star}}(b=1\mid\operatorname{do}(a=0))=537/2318\), and \(\Pr_{M_{1\star}}(b=1\mid\operatorname{do}(a=1))=3/4\) whereas \(\Pr_{M_{2\star}}(b=1\mid\operatorname{do}(a=1))=1781/2318\); the differences are \(85/4636\) and \(-85/4636\). Every refinement of \(H_{\star}\) is a DAG and hence is locally identified, but the macro effect is not uniformly identified. This is vertex-minimal among feasible directed cycles containing two adjacent singleton clusters: a cycle consisting only of singleton clusters would force a directed micro-cycle, so three clusters and one additional vertex are necessary, and sizes \((1,1,2)\) attain the bound. Consequently, any terminating saturation satisfying the ranked overlap handle and its exact equality-or-separation invariant must detect or reproduce a valid separating certificate for this input.
body.justification: The explicit arithmetic collision establishes a strict, independently checkable failure of refinement-by-refinement identification in the smallest adjacent-singleton cyclic regime.
body.gap: AnandRibeiroTianBareinboim2023CDAG excludes cyclic cluster graphs, while FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG does not decide common-law disagreement between individually identified exact refinements.
body.consumer: It gives the cyclic lisinopril--stroke grouping a concrete warning pattern and supplies a regression test that every candidate overlap saturation must pass.
